summary: The set of keys backend_app/backend/backtesting_engine.py's run_backtest_async puts on its results dict, on EITHER engine path (vectorbt and the no-vectorbt fallback). The writer (backtest_service.py) and the results screen (algo22-terminal/src/pages/Backtester.jsx) each read a subset of this set; anything either of them reads that is absent here is read against a key the engine never emits.
one_file_note: This file is the single copy. pytest (tests/test_backtest_key_contract.py) reads it directly at tests/fixtures/backtest_payload_keys.json; vitest (algo22-terminal/tests/unit/pages/backtesterNetPnl.test.jsx) reads the same path through node:fs, repo-relative. A per-side copy could drift, which is the failure mode this fixture exists to remove.

producer.note: The Python frozenset beside the two engine paths' results dict literals. This file is emitted FROM that declaration (a one-off dump, not hand-typed); tests/test_backtest_key_contract.py asserts a real run's key set on each path equals the declaration exactly, and a separate assertion asserts this JSON equals the declaration, so neither side of this file can go stale without a red test.

both_paths_emit_the_same_set.note: The primary (vectorbt) and fallback (no-vectorbt) engine paths were expected to differ - the fallback derives a winning_trades/losing_trades split the primary path once lacked - but task 7.6 (already landed) gave the primary path a matching producer, so both paths now emit the identical 16 keys below. Verified against a real run of each path, not assumed.
